Name: Ragnarok Online Hats for Fashion Sense
Author: Solariaze
Description:
[color=#cfe2f3][b]Elevate your style with these finely crafted hats that pay homage to the game's beloved characters and aesthetics from the classic and widely popular [i]Ragnarok Online MMORPG[/i]. Upgrade your fashion game with these Ragnarok-inspired hat collection![/b][/color]

[b][size=4]Installation Guide[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url].﻿
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[color=#cfe2f3]This is a Fashion Sense mod conversion of the hit mod [/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2717]Ragnarok Online Hats (Content Patcher and Json Assets)[/url][color=#cfe2f3] made by [/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/53667001]Sephy[/url][color=#cfe2f3].[/color]

[color=#d9d2e9]Mods included at the images for aesthetic[/color][i] [/i][spoiler][list=1]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15140]Witchy Rusty Looks for Fashion Sense[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10294]﻿Shardust's Animated Hairstyles for Fashion Sense[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11266]Sakura Interface[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1213]Natural Color - Reshade[/url]﻿[/spoiler]
[/list]
